name: devkit
description: Engineering + product + support toolkit. Seven goal-oriented verbs (ship, bootstrap, review, understand, product, deliver, support) that route internally to a library of senior-role personas and pipelines, plus PRD authoring, Playwright E2E and PR review. External services are reached via vendor-recommended tooling first (twg CLI for Atlassian, gh for GitHub), then vendor MCPs, then gitkraken MCP, then REST.
